recipes.name: Root Beer Noodles inspired by The Simpsons
ingredients: For the Root Beer Braised Short Ribs
As needed freshly ground black pepper
For the Cheeto Root Beer Noodles
instructions: For the Root Beer-Braised Short Ribs
Preheat the oven to 275 °F with convection fan.
Season the short ribs with salt and pepper on all sides. - 5 ½ in short ribs (bone in) - As needed kosher salt - As needed freshly ground black pepper
Heat a large dutch oven or high-sided skillet over medium-high heat. Add the oil to the skillet to preheat. - 1 tbsp vegetable oil

Add the onion to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes. Then, add the carrots, celery, and garlic and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes. - 1 large yellow onion chopped - 3 medium carrots peeled + chopped - 2 celery stalks chopped - 4 cloves garlic crushed
Add the tomato paste to the vegetable mixture and stir to combine, cook for 1 minute. - 3 tbsp tomato paste
Place the short ribs on top of the vegetables, bone-side up.
Pour in the soy sauce, root beer, and just enough chicken stock to come about ¾ of the way up the sides of the short ribs. - ¼ cup soy sauce - 1 ½ cup root beer - 3 ½ cup chicken stock
Add the thyme and parsley to the cooking liquid, then place the uncovered skillet in the preheated oven. - 5 ½ sprigs fresh thyme - 3 stems parsley (leaves included)

Braise the short ribs for 3-4 hours, checking periodically for doneness. Halfway through cooking, flip the short ribs to expose the meat side. If the liquid becomes too shallow, add more chicken stock as necessary.
Once the meat is fork-tender, remove the short ribs from the braising liquid and keep warm until ready to serve.
Strain and reserve all of the cooking liquid for the pasta sauce.
For the Cheeto Pasta Dough
Combine flour, cheddar dust, msg, and eggs in a food processor. - 5 ½ oz all purpose flour - 1 ½ oz masa - ½ oz cheddar cheese powder - ⅛ tsp MSG - 5 oz eggs
Process for 60 seconds until the dough ball forms. Remove the dough from the processor and form it into a ball.
Wrap the dough tightly and rest for a minimum of 1 hour at room temperature or up to overnight in the fridge.

Using a pasta roller, work in batches to roll out the dough. Start on the widest setting and decrease the size by two settings with every roll. Roll until the dough reaches the second thinnest setting (or to your preference).
Cut into long strips about 6 to 8 mm thick.
For the Cheeto Root Beer Noodles
Fill a large high-sided skillet or pot with water. Season the water with salt and bring it to a boil. - As needed water - 1 tbsp kosher salt
Meanwhile, prepared a large skillet with the braising liquid and short ribs. Bring the mixture to a bare simmer. Cook until slightly thickened. - 1 cup reserved braising liquid - Braised Short Ribs
Add the cheeto pasta and cook for 1-2 minutes or until al dente. - Cheeto Pasta

Using tongs, transfer the cooked pasted directly in the pan with the preheated sauce. Turn off the heat and finish the pasta with the butter. Toss the pasta to coat and season to taste with kosher salt, if necessary. - 2 tbsp unsalted butter - kosher salt
Serve immediately with a garnish of grated cheeto. - 1 cheeto grated
